ms.promise:
A. An on-chain traceability feature that records key store order events as immutable transaction data.
B. An on-chain escrow contract that holds funds between buyer and seller until released by a shipping-related event.
C. An on-chain reputation feature that provides badge tokens that reflect buyer and seller interactions with the system.
D. Documentation describing how the advanced on-chain features work.
ms.criteria:
A1. The order traceability feature successfully generates on-chain transactions that record data from key store order events.
B1. The escrow contract holds funds on-chain between buyer and seller and can be released using a shipping-related trigger, demonstrated through at least 2 tested escrow release scenarios.
C1. The reputation feature generates reputation metrics from buyer and seller interactions recorded on-chain, demonstrated through issuance of at least 2 test badge tokens.
D1. Documentation explaining how to deploy and use the advanced on-chain features is publicly available.
